fullPassage:
Becoming aware of our internal sensations can help us handle our own emotions. Perhaps more surprisingly, the body's interoceptive faculty can also bring us into closer contact with other people's emotions. That's because the brain, on its own, has no direct access to the contents of other people's minds, no way to feel what others are feeling. Interpreting others' spoken words and facial expressions may yield only a coolly abstract sense of the emotions that stir within. The body acts as a critical conduit, supplying the brain with the visceral information it lacks. It does so in this way: When interacting with other people, we subtly and unconsciously mimic their facial expressions, gestures, posture, and vocal pitch. Then, via the interoception of our own bodies' signals, we perceive what the other person is feeling because we feel it in ourselves. We bring other people's feelings onboard, and the body is the bridge. In an act similar to taking a bite off our partner's plate, or borrowing an earbud to hear the song our friend is listening to, we are ____________________.

* interoceptive: 내부 감각 수용의 ** conduit: 전달자 *** visceral: 본능적인

questions.passage:
Becoming aware of our internal sensations can help us handle our own emotions.

(A) It does so in this way: When interacting with other people, we subtly and unconsciously mimic their facial expressions, gestures, posture, and vocal pitch.
(B) Perhaps more surprisingly, the body's interoceptive faculty can also bring us into closer contact with other people's emotions. That's because the brain, on its own, has no direct access to the contents of other people's minds.
(C) The body acts as a critical conduit, supplying the brain with the visceral information it lacks.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 첫 문장(내부 감각 인식) → (B) 타인의 감정과 접촉, 뇌의 한계 → (C) 몸이 전달자 역할 → (A) 구체적 방법(표정 모방)
det.analysis:
(B): 주제 전환(타인의 감정) + 뇌의 한계 제시
(C): 몸이 핵심 전달자(conduit) 역할
(A): "It does so"가 (C)의 conduit 역할을 구체적으로 설명
det.tip: It does so(A)가 (C)의 내용을 받으므로 C→A 순서 확정

questions.passage: When interacting with other people, we subtly and ①<u>unconsciously</u> mimic their facial expressions, ②<u>gestures</u>, posture, and vocal pitch. Then, via the interoception of our own bodies' signals, we perceive what the other person is feeling in a purely ③<u>rational</u> way. The body acts as a critical ④<u>conduit</u>, supplying the brain with the ⑤<u>visceral</u> information it lacks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ rational(이성적인) → 원문에서는 감정을 "우리 안에서 느끼기(feel it in ourselves)" 때문에 인식한다고 하므로, 이성적인 방식이 아닌 체험적/감각적 방식입니다.
det.analysis:
① unconsciously: 원문 그대로 (적절)
② gestures: 원문 그대로 (적절)
③ rational: 원문은 감각적 체험 → rational(이성적)은 부적절
④ conduit: 원문 그대로 (적절)
⑤ visceral: 원문 그대로 (적절)
det.tip: rational(이성적) ↔ experiential/visceral(체험적): 본문은 신체를 통한 감각적 체험을 강조
